related.title: Terraform：期望、狀態與真實資源漂移
related.titleEn: Terraform: desired configuration, state and resource drift
related.why:
用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 probes.csv、三種探針責任表與故障時間線。
另一位學徒應能從原始輸入重算結果並重現至少一個反例。
related.whyEn:
Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver probes.csv, a probe-responsibility table and failure timeline.
A second learner must reproduce results and at least one counterexample from the original inputs.
related.difference: 建立desired/state/observed三欄差異；說明採接納標籤後仍需重建遺失資源，動作數降為1。 完成預測、觀察與反例的對照。
related.differenceEn: Build a desired/state/observed diff; adopting changed tags still requires recreating the missing resource, reducing actions to1. Compare prediction,observation and counterexamples.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
基準 30*10 = 300 s；對照 3*5 = 15 s。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
畫出每次探測時間與結果；說明300與15是配置預算，不是從任意故障瞬間起精確的重啟延遲。

基準 1+2 = 3 resource-actions；對照 1+0 = 1 resource-actions。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
建立desired/state/observed三欄差異；說明採接納標籤後仍需重建遺失資源，動作數降為1。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Baseline 30*10 = 300 s; comparison 3*5 = 15 s. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Plot probe times and outcomes;300 and15 are configuration budgets, not exact restart latencies measured from an arbitrary fault onset.

Baseline 1+2 = 3 resource-actions; comparison 1+0 = 1 resource-actions. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Build a desired/state/observed diff; adopting changed tags still requires recreating the missing resource, reducing actions to1.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: HdrHistogram：尾延遲與分位數不可平均
related.titleEn: HdrHistogram: tail latency and non-averagable quantiles
related.why:
用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 probes.csv、三種探針責任表與故障時間線。
另一位學徒應能從原始輸入重算結果並重現至少一個反例。
related.whyEn:
Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver probes.csv, a probe-responsibility table and failure timeline.
A second learner must reproduce results and at least one counterexample from the original inputs.
related.difference: 合併1000筆排序後第990筆為10 ms，第991筆1000 ms；整體p99=10 ms而非505，p99.1則1000 ms。 完成預測、觀察與反例的對照。
related.differenceEn: After merging,the990th sample is10 ms and991st1000 ms;global p99=10 ms rather than505,and p99.1=1000 ms. Compare prediction,observation and counterexamples.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
基準 30*10 = 300 s；對照 3*5 = 15 s。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
畫出每次探測時間與結果；說明300與15是配置預算，不是從任意故障瞬間起精確的重啟延遲。

基準 (10+1000)/2 = 505 ms；對照 ceil(0.99*1000) = 990 rank。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
合併1000筆排序後第990筆為10 ms，第991筆1000 ms；整體p99=10 ms而非505，p99.1則1000 ms。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Baseline 30*10 = 300 s; comparison 3*5 = 15 s. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Plot probe times and outcomes;300 and15 are configuration budgets, not exact restart latencies measured from an arbitrary fault onset.

Baseline (10+1000)/2 = 505 ms; comparison ceil(0.99*1000) = 990 rank. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
After merging,the990th sample is10 ms and991st1000 ms;global p99=10 ms rather than505,and p99.1=1000 ms.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
